mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 62 degrees under overcast skies near the Verona Public Library, and we are currently seeing a Waning Gibbous moon phase.

City officials have announced that a section of Highway M near the future Aldi construction site will be closed from October 6 through October 9 for road improvements, including paving and shoulder work, so please follow the posted detours on Old PB, East Verona Avenue, and South Main Street.

We have a busy couple of days ahead with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market happening today, plus you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's or yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by the ART House 360 happy hour tomorrow.
Looking at recent reports, on September 21, an individual was identified and cited for retail theft after shoplifting Swedish Fish candy from a local business on East Verona Avenue.
Today's delicious flavor is Double Strawberry, and you can head over to the restaurant when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
